name: chat-app-root
description: Root configuration to run both backend and frontend of the Chat App

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "yellow,blue" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "yellow,blue" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
